name: Scary Macaque's
summary: Experience the world of Scary Macaque's, where you can run, hide, and jump! Step into the world of a monkey species that we've created exclusively for this game. Embark on exciting adventures across a variety of maps, including the Forest, Shop and even a Horror Mode, which will be added later soon! Engage with other players through our multiplayer feature, fostering a sense of community as you explore Scary Macaque's together.
